_comment: Justified divergences between the `just check` target list and .github/workflows/ci.yml job names. Every entry MUST carry a non-empty reason; false records a known, deliberate omission.

divergences.name: check-charters
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate to enforce shipped charter-defect detectors over this repo's two enumerated charters; this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add the matching CI matrix job.

divergences.name: check-ci-parity
divergences.reason: This is the janitor/local aggregate guard introduced by livespec-console-beads-fabro-ccycuk. It reads CI's committed workflow but this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: check-fork-drift
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate because its upstream lane depends on installed orchestrator plugin state that CI does not provision; the gate itself prints a loud skip when that lane cannot resolve.

divergences.name: check-mutants
divergences.reason: Merge-gate mutation run (livespec-console-beads-fabro-txtzn5.10). Deliberately absent from the `just check` aggregate: SPECIFICATION/non-functional-requirements.md ratifies that `just check` MUST NOT include mutation runs. It also cannot run there — it needs a base ref to diff against, which a local aggregate invocation has no way to supply.

divergences.name: check-plan-anchor-declared
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate to enforce the opt-in plan lifecycle anchor convention; this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: check-red-green-replay
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate to validate origin/master..HEAD Rust commits before Stage 3 commit-msg enforcement; this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: check-spec-governance-default-block
divergences.reason: Runs in the janitor/local aggregate as a hermetic spec-governance guard; CI's matrix predates this target and this factory slice may not edit .github/workflows/ to add a new CI job.

divergences.name: ci-green
divergences.reason: Aggregate branch-protection rollup job, not an executable check target.

divergences.name: export-telemetry
divergences.reason: Closed-loop Honeycomb CI telemetry export (the fleet-standard export-ci-telemetry.sh); needs gh API access to the run's own job data and a Honeycomb ingest secret, neither of which a local `just check` invocation has.
